mapper.select: SELECT asset_id,request_hash FROM private_asset_upload_request WHERE owner_user_id=#{ownerUserId} AND request_id=#{requestId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM private_asset WHERE id=#{assetId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM private_asset WHERE owner_user_id=#{ownerUserId} AND purpose=#{purpose} AND id IN #{id} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE private_asset SET source_object_version_ref=#{versionRef},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{assetId} AND status IN ('UPLOADING','SCANNING')
UPDATE private_asset SET status='SCANNING',version=version+1 WHERE id=#{assetId} AND status='UPLOADING'
UPDATE private_asset SET status=#{status},scan_provider_version=#{providerVersion}, scan_result_code=#{resultCode},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{assetId} AND status IN ('UPLOADING','SCANNING')

UPDATE private_asset SET status='READY',object_version_ref=#{versionRef}, object_sha256=#{objectSha256},media_type=#{mediaType},bytes=#{bytes}, scan_provider_version=#{providerVersion},scan_result_code=#{resultCode}, ready_at=NOW(3),version=version+1 WHERE id=#{assetId} AND status IN ('UPLOADING','SCANNING')
mapper.select: SELECT *, (expires_at<=NOW(3)) AS expired FROM private_asset_read_grant WHERE operator_id=#{operatorId} AND request_id=#{requestId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT *, (expires_at<=NOW(3)) AS expired FROM private_asset_read_grant WHERE token_digest=#{tokenDigest} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE private_asset_read_grant SET status='CONSUMED',consumed_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='ISSUED' AND expires_at>NOW(3)
UPDATE private_asset_read_grant SET status='EXPIRED' WHERE id=#{id} AND status='ISSUED'
